guard: the manager's boot-resolved uv executable reaches the Hermes launcher and is the command it executes

mutations.name: Hermes launch drops the manager-boot uv path
mutations.expectRed: the exact manager-boot uv path reaches the launcher
mutations.cell: the exact manager-boot uv path reaches the launcher

mutations.name: Hermes gateway spawn ignores the manager-boot uv path
mutations.expectRed: the gateway spawn executes the exact manager-boot uv path
mutations.cell: the gateway spawn executes the exact manager-boot uv path

mutations.name: Hermes version inspection ignores the manager-boot uv path
mutations.expectRed: version inspection executes the exact manager-boot uv path
mutations.cell: version inspection executes the exact manager-boot uv path
